card.name: Publisher details in citations
card.fires_on: Words inside a bibliography entry where the publisher or place of publication is being given, such as a publisher's name, city, or copyright line after the book title.

modes.label: Publisher or place name
modes.description: A word within the publisher name or city in a reference entry.
modes.example: Whitehouse<< Station>>, NJ: Merck Research Laboratories;

modes.label: Copyright line after encyclopedia
modes.description: The word Copyright after an encyclopedia edition citation.
modes.example: The Columbia Electronic Encyclopedia, 6th ed.<< Copyright>> © 2012,

modes.label: ISBN or year digits
modes.description: A digit within an ISBN or publication year at the end of a reference.

card.writes: It suppresses publisher and journal words, so it seems to lower the chance of another publisher name coming next.
card.plain: It marks the publisher or place part of a book citation, where the publisher has just been named.
